instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: She is learning to speak her first full ((sentence)).
atoms.finishSound: She is learning to speak her first full sentence.

atoms.b: It is ((possible)) that some of the apples have gone off.
atoms.finishSound: It is possible that some of the apples have gone off.

atoms.b: It is important to get it ((straight)).
atoms.finishSound: It is important to get it straight.

atoms.b: If she does not budget properly, her money will ((disappear)).
atoms.finishSound: If she doesn’t budget properly, her money will disappear.

atoms.b: Diamonds are ((actually)) one of the hardest materials.
atoms.finishSound: Diamonds are actually one of the hardest materials.

atoms.b: Digital streaming services drove film rental shops out of ((business)).
atoms.finishSound: Digital streaming services drove film rental shops out of business.

atoms.b: When it comes to songs, it is hard to choose a ((favourite)).
atoms.finishSound: When it comes to songs, it is hard to choose a favourite.
